## Summary

The `POST /api/owners` pipeline now emits an audit line on successful create.

**New step** — `src/main/java/.../rest/function/owner/AuditOwnerCreated.java`: a single-method OfficeFloor function that reads the persisted `@Val Owner` and logs to the dedicated `AUDIT` logger (`LoggerFactory.getLogger("AUDIT")`) the owner id, `customerCode` and `registrationDate`.

**Wiring** — `owners.POST.yml`: inserted an `audit` step between `save` and `respond`. It runs after `SaveOwner` (so the owner has its persisted id) and under the same `transaction` governance as the surrounding steps.

The acceptance test `coreLogsAuditOnCreate` passes — the observed line was `AUDIT - owner created id=11 customerCode=TOW-SUR-0001 registrationDate=2026-08-17`, which contains all three required fields (`registrationDate` is a `LocalDate`, whose `toString()` is the same ISO-8601 form serialized in the response JSON the test compares against).
